messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: symmetry-anchored ansatz from finite reflection or crystallographic groups

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration is the 13 points of the square lattice 4x4 grid with one corner removed, scaled to the unit square, having coordinates {0, 1/3, 2/3, 1}² minus (0,0); this configuration is invariant under reflection across the diagonal y=x, and its smallest triangle area equals 1/18 (arising from collinear-triple adjacencies like (0,1/3),(1/3,1/3),(2/3,1/3)). No arrangement of 13 points in the unit square can achieve a larger minimum triangle area than 1/18."}
